meta.notes: A drift race on the real Crown Point loops (the Historic Columbia River Highway: 17 corners of at least 60 degrees, 7 of them hairpins), the tier-3 drift event (playtest 3, the maintainer: "Braking into a hairpin at speeds makes a nice drift like mechanism"; the critic's C4 and G5). A classic race whose second required objective is $300 of drift style cash (the HUD reads DRIFT $x/$300; other style does not count), so finishing the pack and sliding the hairpins both matter; the optional podium bonus is the usual 0.15 W. The target is not the purse-based figure the progression spec drew ($1,750, 0.6 W): the scripted drift bot (tests/sim/drift-events.test.ts) rides this route alone at this event's own drift rate ($36 a second of full slip, 3 times the oncoming rate) and banks $562 on the weakest bike a player could own by now and $614 to $1,093 on the rest, so the critic's cap of 60 % of what the bot earns is $337 and the target is $300 below it, rounded down to $50. A test fails if any drift event's target goes over its cap. The purse, the style rewards and the rival pace are global tier 7's, as the Gorge race beside it. [default] every number and name.
